description_zh: 李自成（1606-1645），本名鸿基，小名黄来儿/硙生，明朝陕西米脂人。早年为驿卒，崇祯裁撤驿站失业后起义，投王二、归高迎祥、号八队闯将，后自立闯王。统军十余年，推行"均田免赋"、"流动作战"、"攻心争民"，推翻明王朝，于西安建立大顺政权，改元永昌。攻占北京，崇祯自缢，明亡。后山海关败给吴三桂、多尔衮联军，撤京西逃，在湖北九宫山兵败身亡。虽最终失败，但其军事机动战术、民心动员能力、实用主义决策、从零到巅峰的组织跃迁，构成了中国历史上最完整的农民起义成功-建政-失败全周期案例。
description_en: Li Zicheng (1606-1645), born Hongji, childhood name Huanglaizi/Huosheng, from Mizhi, Shaanxi, late Ming Dynasty. Formerly a post station courier, unemployed after Chongzhen abolished stations, he rose in rebellion, joining Wang Er, then Gao Yingxiang as 'Eighth Squad Vanguard General', later proclaiming himself 'Chuang King'. Commanding for over a decade, he implemented 'Equal Land Tax Exemption', 'Mobile Warfare', 'Hearts and Minds Campaign', overthrew the Ming, established the Great Shun regime in Xi'an with era name Yongchang. Captured Beijing, Chongzhen hanged himself, Ming fell. Later defeated at Shanhai Pass by Wu Sangui and Dorgon's allied forces, retreated west, died at Jiugong Mountain, Hubei. Despite ultimate failure, his mobile warfare tactics, mass mobilization capability, pragmatic decision-making, and zero-to-peak organizational leap constitute the most complete full-cycle case of peasant rebellion success-state building-failure in Chinese history.
reason_zh: 核心思维模式：M05（流动作战法/均田免赋法/攻心争民法/实用主义法/政权建构法/关键节点决策法/组织跃迁法）。李自成体现了平民统帅的极致实战智慧：出身底层无正统教育，却创造了机动战术体系（以走制敌、避实击虚、猛快巧准）；深谹民心痛点，以"均田免赋"三大法宝（三年免征、随闯王不纳粮、开仓济民）实现跨阶级动员；极致实用主义（不用古法、唯实战检验真理），在绝境中捕捉机会、快速决策；完成从游击队到大军团到国家机器的组织跃迁管理。其失败教训（无根据地建设、政权建设滞后、内部制衡失效、战略冒进、阶级局限、民族战略缺位）同样极具思维模式价值。
reason_en: Core thinking modes: M05 (Mobile Warfare Method/Equal Land Tax Exemption Method/Hearts and Minds Campaign Method/Pragmatism Method/Regime Construction Method/Critical Node Decision Method/Organizational Leap Method). Li Zicheng embodies the ultimate practical wisdom of a plebeian commander: born at the bottom without orthodox education, yet created a mobile warfare system (maneuver to control enemy, avoid strong attack weak, fierce-fast-clever-precise); deeply understood people's pain points, achieved cross-class mobilization with 'Equal Land Tax Exemption' three treasures (three-year tax exemption, follow Chuang King pay no grain, open granaries for relief); extreme pragmatism (reject ancient methods, only combat tests truth), seized opportunities in desperate straits, rapid decision-making; accomplished organizational leap from guerrilla band to grand army to state apparatus. His failure lessons (no base area construction, regime building lag, internal checks failure, strategic adventurism, class limitations, ethnic strategy vacuum) are equally valuable as thinking mode cases.
steps_zh: 第1步：流动作战思维法——以走制敌机动体系：打破传统阵地战教条，建立骑兵核心、步骑协同、千里奔袭、声东击西、诱敌深入、围城打援的机动战术体系，在优势敌人围追堵截中保存实力、寻机歼敌
第2步：均田免赋思维法——民心动员最大公约数：以"均田免粮、平买平卖、割富济贫、开仓济民、三年免征"政策组合，精准击中贫农/中小地主/城市贫民痛点，构建跨阶级联盟，将民心转化为兵源、粮源、情报源
第3步：攻心争民思维法——舆论造势与心理瓦解：将"迎闯王不纳粮"口号民谣化传播，以严纪律树仁义师形象，以招降纳叛瓦解敌军体系，以合法性仪式（改元、开科、祭天）建构政权正统性，实现政治战与军事战融合
第4步：实用主义思维法——唯实战检验真理：拒绝书本教条与形而上争论，真理标准唯一指向实战胜负、民心向背、队伍壮大。用人不问出身论功行赏，战术随地形敌情即时调整，经济以战养战就地取材，形成极端实用主义认识论与行动论
第5步：政权建构思维法——从军队到国家的体制转型：内阁改天佑殿、六部增设、省级节度使、文武官制重定、开科取士吸纳知识分子、铸永昌通宝整顿财政、废八股取散文重塑文化，演练政权建构全流程
第6步：关键节点决策思维法——历史窗口期的果断抉择：起义决策（捕捉裁撤驿站机遇）、合流选择（动态调整盟友）、根据地抉择（西安vs襄阳vs南京vs北京）、北伐时机（追求加冕合法性）、山海关抉择（招降失败后强攻），展现危机中机会捕捉与雷厉风行
第7步：组织跃迁思维法——规模扩张与管控的辩证管理：小股起义→大军团→政权雏形的组织进化；军事民主（分赃制、兄弟义气）向军事集权（将军制、军法制）转型；内部矛盾动态处理（联合罗汝才→消灭罗汝才，重用李岩→杀李岩），揭示组织弹性与管控失效的临界点
steps_en: Step 1: Mobile Warfare Thinking Method - Maneuver Control System: breaking traditional positional warfare dogma, establishing cavalry-core, infantry-cavalry coordination, thousand-mile raids, feint east attack west, lure enemy deep, besiege city to relieve ally mobile tactics system, preserving strength and seeking annihilation opportunities under superior enemy encirclement

Step 2: Equal Land Tax Exemption Thinking Method - Mass Mobilization Greatest Common Divisor: using 'equal land tax exemption, fair trade, rob rich aid poor, open granaries relief, three-year tax exemption' policy package, precisely hitting pain points of poor peasants/small landlords/urban poor, building cross-class alliance, converting popular support into manpower, grain, intelligence sources

Step 3: Hearts and Minds Campaign Thinking Method - Opinion Offensive and Psychological Disintegration: spreading 'Welcome Chuang King Pay No Grain' slogan as folk ballads, establishing righteous army image with strict discipline, disintegrating enemy system through surrender recruitment, constructing regime legitimacy through rituals (era change, imperial exams, heaven worship), achieving political-military fusion

Step 4: Pragmatism Thinking Method - Only Combat Tests Truth: rejecting book dogma and metaphysical disputes, truth standard singularly points to combat victory, popular support direction, troop growth. Employing regardless of origin rewarding merit, tactics adjusting instantly to terrain/enemy, economy feeding war locally, forming extreme pragmatist epistemology and praxeology

Step 5: Regime Construction Thinking Method - Army to State Systemic Transition: Cabinet→Tianyu Hall, Six Ministries expanded, provincial commissioners, civil-military ranks redefined, imperial exams recruiting intellectuals, minting Yongchang Tongbao reforming finance, abolishing eight-legged essays for prose reshaping culture, rehearsing full regime construction process

Step 6: Critical Node Decision Thinking Method - Decisive Choices at Historical Windows: rebellion decision (seizing station abolition opportunity), alliance choices (dynamically adjusting allies), base choice (Xi'an vs Xiangyang vs Nanjing vs Beijing), northern expedition timing (pursuing coronation legitimacy), Shanhai Pass choice (forced attack after recruitment failed), demonstrating crisis opportunity capture and lightning execution

Step 7: Organizational Leap Thinking Method - Dialectical Management of Scale Expansion and Control: guerrilla band→grand army→regime embryo organizational evolution; military democracy (loot sharing, brotherhood) transitioning to military centralization (general system, military law); internal contradictions dynamic handling (ally Ro Rucai→eliminate Ro, employ Li Yan→kill Li Yan), revealing critical thresholds of organizational elasticity and control failure

expected_en: Establish mobile tactics system, achieving weak defeating strong, few defeating many under superior enemy encirclement
With 'Equal Land Tax Exemption' as core program, achieve cross-class mass mobilization of poor peasants/small landlords/urban poor
Through hearts-and-minds campaign and psychological warfare, disintegrate enemy morale and ruling legitimacy, achieving victory without battle
Establish pragmatist epistemology, achieving rapid decision-making and agile execution under extreme resource constraints

case_zh: 李自成出身驿卒，崇祯四年（1631）因裁撤驿站失业起义，投王二、归高迎祥、号八队闯将；王自用病故后与张献忠合兵，击败明总兵邓玘；高迎祥被杀后被推为闯王，领众"以走致敌"，采取声东击西、避实击虚战法，连下阶州、陇州、宁羌。崇祯十六年（1643）称新顺王，改襄阳为襄京，提出"均田免粮"口号。崇祯十七年（1644）正月西安称帝，建国号大顺，改元永昌，定军制、封功臣、开科取士。三月攻占北京，推翻明朝。后招降吴三桂不成，山海关与吴三桂、多尔衮联军决战败北，退师北京，四十二天京师统治结束。撤京西逃，途经河南、湖北，清军两路合围，部将纷纷投降或战死，最终在湖北通山九宫山为地方武装所杀，终年40岁。其军事机动战术、民心动员术、实用主义决策、组织跃迁管理，构成完整实战思维案例库。
case_en: Li Zicheng, born a post courier, rebelled in 1631 (Chongzhen 4) after station abolition caused unemployment, joined Wang Er, submitted to Gao Yingxiang as Eighth Squad Vanguard; after Wang Ziyong died, allied with Zhang Xianzhong, defeated Ming General Deng Qi; after Gao killed, acclaimed Chuang King, led troops 'maneuver to control enemy', using feint east attack west, avoid strong hit weak tactics, successively captured Jiezhou, Longzhou, Ningqiang. 1643 proclaimed New Shun King, renamed Xiangyang to Xiangjing, raised 'Equal Land Tax Exemption' slogan. 1644 January enthroned in Xi'an, state name Great Shun, era Yongchang, established military system, enfeoffed meritocrats, opened imperial exams. March captured Beijing, overthrew Ming. Later failed to recruit Wu Sangui, defeated at Shanhai Pass by Wu-Dorgon allied forces, retreated from Beijing, 42-day capital rule ended. Retreated west through Henan, Hubei, Qing two-pronged encirclement, generals surrendered or died, finally killed by local militia at Jiugong Mountain, Tongshan, Hubei, aged 40. His mobile warfare tactics, mass mobilization art, pragmatist decision-making, organizational leap management constitute a complete practical thinking case library.
